jobs.name: 유리
jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished original character exploration board for Memory Forge, a Korean anime fantasy RPG about memories, brass clockwork, and a harbor city. Landscape 1536x1024 composition.
Style: exceptionally appealing polished anime game concept illustration, precise expressive line art, clean cel shading with delicate painted lighting, beautiful readable faces, art-directed color and shape design. Youthful teenage adventurer, about six to six-and-a-half heads tall in the full-body figure, lightly rounded cheeks, lively brows, modest nose and small mouth. NOT chibi and NOT mature fashion-model proportions.
Layout: one large fully visible head-to-toe three-quarter character on the left half, three expressive head-and-shoulder studies across the upper right, and one small waist-up everyday acting vignette on the lower right. The same character, outfit, eye color and accessories must remain consistent in all five depictions. Ample white space around every head, hand, shoe and prop; never crop the main silhouette. Pale warm ivory paper background with a faint restrained motif; no ornate interface or frames.
Constraints: ordinary non-sexual adventure illustration. Opaque clothing, natural eye-level camera, expressive character acting, practical wearable garments. No writing, letters, captions, logo, watermark or signature. No character from an existing franchise; do not copy a known costume, hat silhouette, hairstyle, signature pose or accessory combination. This is an original Memory Forge design.

Subject: YURI, a gentle and curious 16-year-old girl botanist. Preserve these core identifiers: long pale-blue wavy hair whose last few centimeters look like crystalline glass, kind soft teal-blue eyes, a sleeveless summer sundress underneath an OPEN long lightweight botanist coat, sandals, a small frosted vial at her belt, a brass staff ending in a glass TERRARIUM LANTERN containing tiny gentle glowing creatures and a living sprout. Dress and coat fabric are opaque; only the lantern, vial and hair-tip effect are glasslike.
Design direction: make her cuteness come from curiosity that escapes her usually quiet demeanor. Loose softly curled bangs, two tiny sprout-shaped hair clips, a ribbon fastening a small side section of her hair (not twin tails). Soft milk-blue, fresh sage, warm ivory, little honey-gold accents. Ivory botanist coat with sage cuffs and simple leaf stitching, pale blue knee-length sundress with a softly scalloped petal hem; comfortable tan sandals. Keep detail economical and memorable, a single strong plant-and-glass theme. No elaborate princess gown.
Main full-body pose: she leans a little toward the terrarium staff she holds upright, softly delighted eyes and an almost disbelieving small smile as a sprout glows inside; both feet naturally planted, full shoes visible.
Three portraits in order: a trying-to-look-serious tiny pout with raised brows; caught-in-the-act curious wide eyes as a small light creature peeks from a lock of hair; warm open laughing smile. These are distinct expressions, not the same face repeated.
Lower-right acting vignette: she raises one finger for a tiny glowing leaf creature to land on, then looks at it with amused astonishment, little cheeks and genuinely lively eyes. Draw a tasteful small brass lantern detail nearby. Charming and self-directed, not timid or helpless.

Subject: RIEN, an energetic 17-year-old girl musician. Preserve these core identifiers: pink-blonde TWIN TAILS with graduated rosy tips, bright yellow eyes, oversized soundwave-print hoodie, pleated skirt over black leggings, high-top sneakers, HEADPHONES worn around her neck, and a distinctive electric VIOLIN with glowing strings plus a separate correct violin bow. Music notes and waveform are her motifs. Keep all hoodie fabric opaque and the full leggings.
Design direction: confident little performer whose composure breaks in charming everyday moments, playful and mischievous. The hoodie is creamy vanilla with charcoal inner hood and small brass toggles, a bold simple magenta waveform motif (not writing), soft plum pleated skirt, dark leggings, cream-and-rose high-top sneakers. Brass-and-rose headphones resemble compact circular resonators; subtle clockwork materials on the violin. Her hair sweeps outward in two buoyant medium-long twin tails, clearly pink-blonde and rosy at tips, tied by small waveform ribbons. Aim for a readable strong silhouette, not excessive chains or bows.
Main full-body pose: lively post-performance stance, weight on one foot, violin naturally held low at her side, bow in the other hand pointing gently down and away, delighted proud open smile with one raised brow; full boots and hair visible.
Three portraits in order: theatrical smug proud grin with chin slightly lifted; puffed-cheek annoyance after missing a note, ears and neck relaxed; startled embarrassed laugh when she notices someone heard her practicing. Give her an unusually lively, characterful face, no seductive expression.
Lower-right acting vignette: she listens through one lifted headphone cup, tries to keep a stern professional face while tapping a little beat with her free hand, then fails into a wide happy grin. Correct hand anatomy, two arms only. Clearly show the violin as a violin, not a guitar.

Subject: KAYA, a confident 17-year-old girl detective. Preserve these core identifiers: AUBURN hair in ONE SIDE BRAID, bright ORANGE eyes, a brass magnifying monocle, FEATHERED DETECTIVE CAP, SHORT CAPE, opaque short-sleeve shirt with a vest, tailored shorts, practical long boots, fingerless gloves, a compact CROSSBOW that fires glowing heated bolts. Magnifying glass and fingerprint motifs.
Design direction: self-appointed brilliant detective, mischievous and charmingly easy to read when she is bluffing. Autumn chestnut, ink navy, warm cream, copper-brass, tiny warm orange highlights. The detective cap is a compact rounded tweed cap with a small off-center copper feather, NOT a top hat and NOT a flat black tall hat with flowers. Cape ends at the waist with a subtle asymmetric tab and one magnifier clasp. Ivory collared short-sleeve shirt, navy fitted but practical waistcoat, warm brown mid-thigh tailored shorts, sturdy dark knee-high lace-up boots with low soles. Monocle is flipped up on a tiny articulated hinge over one eye on her cap brim, leaving both eyes readable. Side braid curls at the end and carries one little plain clue-tag ribbon. No lavish ornamentation.
Main full-body pose: one gloved hand raises a little plain clue tag toward her face, head tilts with a smug know-it-all smile and bright teasing eyes; other hand holds the unloaded compact crossbow safely downward at her side, finger off trigger. Full cape, hair braid, both hands, weapon and boots visible.
Three portraits in order: triumphant one-brow-up aha grin; caught bluffing, eyes widen and lips purse in a tiny comic wobble; laughing unguardedly after being outsmarted, eye shape stays consistent.
Lower-right acting vignette: she peers through a hand-held magnifier at a small brass wind-up bird, the bird's eye comically enlarged by the lens, then she looks surprised as it pecks the plain clue tag. The humor comes from her reaction. Do not add a ghost, spirit companion, funeral motifs, flowers, red-black Chinese costume, or copy any existing game's detective design.
